description: Puts the clothes another of the user's photos shows (with_photo_id) on the person in one of their photos, paid from their credits; part top or bottom takes only that part of the outfit. with_photo_id may not be one of a character's photos, nor photo_id itself. Pass the price the user agreed to as max_credits: the photo's prices from get_shoot or list_photos name it. If a call to this tool got no answer, it may already have started: check list_photos before calling it again.

again.description: true only when the user, having seen what this same call made, asks for another (a second re-roll of one photo, another take of one shoot). Without it, the same call repeated within 10 minutes answers with what it made and charges nothing: a request already answered is not a new one.

name: try_on
title: Try on clothes from another photo
